releaseNotes:
### Personal assistant

- Set up a personal assistant with a name, customizable appearance, and seasonal themes.
- Manage assistant memories and return to a dedicated assistant conversation across the workspace.
- Delete the assistant and its associated resources with an explicit confirmation, while preserving unrelated conversations and saved content.

### Studio and conversations

- Unify Studio navigation and conversation controls, with clearer assistant entry points and context handling.
- Improve keyboard shortcuts across macOS and Windows and refine composer mentions and slash commands.
- Preserve image uploads while typing and inline code formatting when replacing selections.
- Improve long-running conversations through context cooling and more compact tool results.

### Reliability and plugins

- Recover project creation, Git writes, content creation, and Widget operations after interrupted responses without duplicating work.
- Preserve project drafts and show background read failures more clearly.
- Keep compatible database rollback backups when an interrupted upgrade is retried.
- Automatically select a single available plugin connection and simplify connection selection when multiple accounts are available.

### Upgrade notes

- The local database upgrades from v48 to v55 with an automatic backup. Restore a matching backup before downgrading.
- macOS requires 14 or later on Apple Silicon, or 15.5 or later on Intel.
- Windows availability follows Microsoft Store certification and rollout separately from the Mac release.
